q: The first action in a convulsing child after ABC is:
e: Hypoglycaemia is common and easy to treat.

q: The dose of rectal diazepam in status epilepticus is:
After two doses of benzodiazepine, what is the next drug?
e: Phenytoin (or phenobarbitone) is the second-line drug.

q: The Cushing triad includes all of the following EXCEPT:
e: The Cushing triad has bradycardia, not tachycardia.
